turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went into the gradebook?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
I didn't say anything about my mind. You haven't answered me: was Owen heard before that mark went in, yes or no?
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
Don't manage me. I can still be in the principal's office by five. What do you have on Owen's essay besides software?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
Owen saw that zero on his phone in the middle of class, so it stopped being between us a week ago. No deal. Show me what you have, or I'm going upstairs.
